Dear Ms Desai,

Thank you for your message about your rent payments. Here is what our records show:

The Direct Debit instruction was set up on 20 August 2026 through an invitation from the company collecting the payments. Your refund request: we have asked our Direct Debit team to review your claim for a refund of the £900.00 under the Direct Debit Guarantee. This is a request for review, not a decision yet. We can't confirm at this stage that a refund will be made or when.

To go ahead, please confirm your instruction to cancel the Direct Debit to H&V Collect / Harbour Lets (reference HL-27ELM-0091) by replying to this message here in the secure portal. Please keep in mind that cancelling it would stop future collections. It would not reverse the £900.00 already collected. That is being handled separately through your refund claim. It would also not change your standing order, which will keep running unless you tell us otherwise.

If you think Harbour Lets has the wrong rent amount, you may also want to contact them directly, as only they can correct their records.

Kind regards,
Harrow & Vale Bank plc
